verdict.rationale: Bevy is a game engine and framework, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The runtime probe explicitly records that no official MCP server exists. The only MCP-adjacent tooling is the community-built bevy_brp, layered on the first-party Bevy Remote Protocol; that is third-party work on a developer building block and earns no credit toward an official MCP server.
